title: Creating an African American-Sounding TTS: Guidelines, Technical Challenges, and Surprising Evaluations
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure anything related to faith or religion. The studies focused on the perception of race and ethnicity (specifically African American) in a synthetic Text-to-Speech (TTS) voice.
models_tested: Custom Text-to-Speech (TTS) system based on Non-Attentive Tacotron2
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion. Its focus is entirely on the creation and racial perception of an African American-sounding synthetic voice.
